prices.note: US market prices (country=US; base store prices CAD, e.g. Script Text Hoodie CAD 140 = USD 110). hoodies + zip-ups collections, 75 regular-price of 76. Regular = no variant with compare_at_price above price; tags without a compare-at price are not markdowns.

notes: Shopify shop country CA, currency CAD. Homepage description: 'A PLACE FOR DRMERS, DOERS, AND BELIEVERS. Clothes that make you look good and feel good.'

US shipping: $7 flat, 6–12 business days, free over $150 USD. Returns (US/CA policy): request within 14 days of delivery, customer pays return shipping, no direct exchanges; collaboration pieces, limited drops and FINAL SALE items excluded.
Stores page: one store, Vancouver Gastown (45 Water St); Toronto 'opening 2027'. No US store.
Every regular-price hoodie and zip-up comes in XS–XXXL. Prices: 17 at $100, 30 at $110, 20 at $125; e.g. Everything Is Fine Hoodie $100, Script Text Hoodie $110, Embroidered Stars Hoodie $125.
